questions.question: Who was the first to arrive at Jesus' tomb on the first day of the week?
options: Peter and John, the two disciples
Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
The mother of Jesus and Salome
questions.answer: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary

questions.question: What did the chief priests pay the soldiers to say about the empty tomb?
options: That Jesus had risen from the dead
That his disciples stole his body
That the tomb was never used
questions.answer: That his disciples stole his body

questions.question: The angel at the tomb told the women not to be afraid.
Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy _____.
Behold, I am with you always, even to the _____ of the age.
